verses.1: And Moses called out to all Israel, saying, “Listen, Israel! Hear these laws and regulations that I am speaking to you today. Learn them and obey them.”
verses.2: The LORD our God has made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.3: The LORD did not break this covenant with our ancestors. For we are here today, all of us alive.
verses.4: The LORD speaks to you face to face on the mountain, in the midst of fire.
verses.5: I stand between Jehovah and you all at that time, to tell you what Jehovah has said. For you are afraid of the fire, and you have not gone up the mountain as it was commanded.
verses.6: I, Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.
verses.7: You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.8: Do not make for yourself any idols of any kind, whether those that are in the heavens above, or those that are on the earth below, or those that are in the waters beneath the earth.
verses.9: Do not worship them, and do not serve them. For I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God who will avenge the offenses of the fathers upon their children, and upon all those who hate me.
verses.10: And he shows mercy to the thousands of my lovers and to those who keep my commandments.
verses.11: Do not carry the name of Jehovah your God as an idol. For Jehovah will not forgive those who carry His name as an idol.
verses.12: Keep Shabbat as a holy day, just as Jehovah your God has commanded you.
verses.13: For six days, you shall work, and do all your tasks.
verses.14: And on the seventh day, Shabbat belongs to Jehovah your God. You shall not do any work on that day—neither you, nor your sons, nor your daughters, nor your servants, nor your animals, nor your crops in your fields. This is so that your servants and your livestock may be able to rest in peace.
verses.15: And you remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt. But Jehovah your God led you out of there with strength and power. Therefore, Jehovah your God commands you to do what is necessary on that day of redemption.
verses.16: Honor your father and your mother, as Jehovah your God commands you. This will ensure that you may live long in life and that everything will go well for you on the land that Jehovah your God has given you.
verses.20: And do not resist your enemy when he comes against you.
verses.21: And you shall not eat food that belongs to your enemy. You shall not also damage the fields, livestock, and everything else that belongs to your enemy.
verses.22: These words were spoken by the LORD to all of you on that mountain, amidst the fire and darkness. It was a great voice, and it never ceased. These words were written on two stone tablets, and they were given to me.
verses.23: And when you heard the sound from within the darkness and the darkness was filled with fire, then all your leaders and elders came to me.
verses.24: And they said, “We have seen the glory of the LORD our God, and His greatness and power. We heard His voice from within the fire today. We saw that God is speaking to man and to all living things.”
verses.25: And now, why do we die when that great fire consumes us? If we still listen to the voice of our God, then He will still give us life.
verses.26: For who can live, after hearing the voice of God? They become alive through the fire, just as we do.
verses.27: You shall hear and do all that Jehovah our God says to you. You shall speak to us about everything that Jehovah our God speaks to you. We will listen and carry out what He commands us to do.
verses.28: And Jehovah heard the sound of their voices as they spoke to Him. And Jehovah said, “I have heard the sound of these people’s voices. They have spoken well in all that they have said.”
verses.29: May they not give in to temptation, and may their hearts be willing to obey all my commandments forever, so that they may be blessed.
verses.30: Go and tell them to go back to their tents.
verses.31: And you stand here with me, and I will speak to you about all the laws, commandments, and regulations that you must learn and follow. These are the laws that I have given them to govern their land.
verses.32: And you shall keep doing what Yahweh your God commands you. Do not go astray from His laws.
verses.33: In all the ways in which the LORD your God has commanded you, go forward so that you may live and be blessed. May you live long years in the land that you will inherit.
